# SEO Content Brief

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing), authored by contributor puneetindersingh: it generates competitive content briefs in one exact structure (scored competitor table, gap analysis, per-section outline and word counts, meta rules, information-gain and E-E-A-T requirements). At use it fetches the target site, its sitemap and the top 5 competitor pages over the network, with optional DataForSEO or Ahrefs MCP data when present. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, forbids naming tools or frameworks in the delivered brief, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
